4279-5687-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4694-5315-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5315-6258-7306.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

654-3129-4365-6753-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-6441-6763-7824-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3263-4017-4186-6830.description:

1116-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4681-6542-6797-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

3490-4455-5147-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4455-5147-7426.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

4050-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-7084-7316.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3532-3536-5078-6604.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

1656-4543-6628.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
1656-4543-6628.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using PuPu UFO's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

813-3306-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Slip On the Ring.
813-3306-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Cast either of the creatures from your hand by paying {0}.
The creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.

Cast the other creature from your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the creature spell cast in step 4, causing it to enter the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

3951-5231-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

509-1267-2003-2392.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
509-1267-2003-2392.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2003-2392.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2003-2392.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 5 through 8 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

2792-2921-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2792-2921-5140.description:

Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Great Whale, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

2082-4186-5256.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-4186-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-4186-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

4050-4871-5003-5374.description:
Whenever an opponent controls a creature, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Keiga, adding {1}.
When Keiga dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Keiga trigger, causing you to gain control of a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature you gained control of in step 3, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Keiga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat as desired and/or whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

337-803-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
337-803-4222-4508.description:

Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

107-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn, adding {C}{C}.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ambitious Aetherborn from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1365-3723-4068-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

539-4916-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
 Animate Artifact attached to Caged Sun.
539-4916-5175.description:
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.

As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.

1061-1869-2963.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control ten or more permanents.
1061-1869-2963.description:

If you don't have the city's blessing, Timesteam Navigator trigges, causing you to get the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Inalla triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-3825-4465-4587-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1636-3825-4465-4587-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

233-714-1284-2178.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature you control without summoning sickness.
233-714-1284-2178.description:

The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat as desired for each land an opponent controls, and whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Mask of Immolation attached to Rograkh.

Resolve the Rograkh ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Mask of Immolation's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Repeat.

2428-3591-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.

Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence ability, exiling the top card of your library and putting that card into your hand at the beginning of the next end step.

65-717-2628-2993-4607.description:
Activate Smoldering Crater's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Smoldering Crater, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.

Stoic Builder enters the battlefield, returning Smoldering Crater from your graveyard to your hand.
